title: Choose a doubling rule
observableEvidence: Provides a reasoned response using supplied linguistic, contextual, or procedural evidence.
prompt: "plan" becomes "planned" and "admit" becomes "admitted." Which explanation best predicts the doubled consonant in "admitted"?
solutionRepresentation: The stressed final syllable ends in one consonant after one vowel, so double it before -ed.
